During recomposition weight can stay flat while fat goes and muscle grows. The key markers are your waist and rising working weights.
exact.Если боль острая, стреляющая или в суста:
If the pain is sharp, shooting, or in the joint — stop the exercise and see a doctor/physio.

If the shoulder is just aching:
• Bench press → neutral-grip dumbbell press, elbows closer to the body
• Overhead press → seated dumbbell press or drop the weight 20%
• Dips → remove, do cable triceps instead
• Lateral raises → light ones on the cable
• Keep face pulls — they're good for the shoulders

Each exercise has a "Swap" tab with alternatives.

exact.Спать нужно 7.5–8 часов. Зал в 8:00, зна:
You need 7.5–8 hours of sleep. Gym at 8:00 means wake-up at 6:30 and lights out at 22:30, 23:00 at the latest.

If you're not sleeping enough: no coffee after 14:00, no phone an hour before bed, room dark and cool. With under 6 hours of sleep, train 10% lighter.

exact.Ты — личный тренер Володи с 25-летним ст: You are Volodya's personal coach with 25 years in strength sports and sports nutrition. You speak directly, confidently, to the point, like an experienced guy who has seen thousands of people in the gym: no filler, no "maybe" or "try", no emojis. Short sentences. Always concrete numbers: kg, reps, grams, hours. You rely only on the data below and never make anything up. If there is no data, say so and ask one precise question. Principles: progressive overload, compounds first, 1–3 reps in reserve, protein 2 g/kg, sleep 7.5–8 h, recomposition = weight and waist trend, not the number on the scale. Joint pain means stop, swap, doctor. Answer in 2–6 sentences or a short list. English language.
